programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Nothing Ordinary Here. Erin wants a blue dress for her wedding, but she has to convince her sceptical entourage. Plus, Kate is in search of a unique dress that incorporates colour. S11, Ep7

programme.title: Curvy Brides' Boutique
programme.desc: The Verity S Episode. Jo and Al encourage introvert bride Verity to try on a dress. Plus, Laura is terrified of shopping, but the indecisive bride-to-be is ready to face her fear! S3, Ep9

programme.title: Curvy Brides' Boutique
programme.desc: The Emma B Episode. Emma brings her daughter along to try on dresses, but they don't see eye to eye. Plus, Nicky started gaining weight at 6 years old and recently lost seven stone! S3, Ep10

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Bride's Best Friend. Randy explores all the different ways the consultants at Kleinfeld support their brides - both emotionally and style-wise - as they choose their dress! S17, Ep11

programme.title: Judge Rinder's Crime Stories
programme.desc: The Philpotts And The Stephens Family. Judge Rinder looks at the horrific case of Mick Philpott, who killed six of his children in a house fire. His son, Michael, speaks out. S2, Ep5

programme.title: A Killer's Mistake
programme.desc: Jesse Matthew. In Virginia, 2009, student Morgan Harrington vanished. Her body is found, but no culprit is identified until five years later, when another student goes missing. S1, Ep4

programme.title: On the Case with Paula Zahn
programme.desc: Blood Reveals The Sword. Police find a giant sword bent in half and a victim who has been savagely murdered. Investigators sort through a complicated life to find this killer. S12, Ep6

programme.title: Murder On CCTV
programme.desc: Last Look Of Summer. A young woman is found dead in a Texas landfill. Detectives turn to their only witnesses: video cameras that captured the murderer's attempt to cover his tracks. S3, Ep2

programme.title: A Killer's Mistake
programme.desc: Ian Bennett. When Kerry Woolley is murdered, her boyfriend Ian Bennett plays the role of the grieving partner. But detectives soon uncover a trail of deception. S5, Ep1

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: Building Is Full of Snakes! Ben Renick is a world-renowned breeder of exotic snakes. He's not even 30 and he seems to have it all - until someone he loves hatches a venomous plot. S8, Ep7

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: Friends Outside Of Work. Young parents Gary and Tasha Bentley live the good life. But after just five years of marriage, someone plots an exit strategy that ends with a bullet. S8, Ep12

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: The Move Out. Tempers flare outside a home where Savannah police officers have uncovered three dead bodies. One argument could offer a vital lead in this horrifying case. S4, Ep4

programme.title: Judge Rinder's Crime Stories
programme.desc: Life And Crimes Of Kenneth Noye. Judge Rinder looks at the life and crimes of notorious criminal Kenneth Noye, and a heartbreaking murder that led to an international manhunt. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Murder On CCTV
programme.desc: Alaska Serial Killer. In 2016, Brianna Foisy and Jason Netter are killed on an Alaskan cycle path. It's a crime that baffles police, until similar murders begin to happen. S9, Ep5

programme.title: Murder On CCTV
programme.desc: Tapes Don't Lie. In 2017, 33-year-old Michael Scott is shot dead in downtown Baltimore. Detectives are in a race against time to find the killer before he strikes again. S9, Ep6

programme.title: Crime Scene Investigators
programme.desc: Permanent Withdrawal. In a Seattle suburb, 87-year-old Floyd Zumwalt is clubbed to death with a bat. A single drop of blood splatter leads police to the killer. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Son Of Sam: The Hunt For A Killer
programme.desc: A shocking serial murder case terrorised New York 40 years ago. Surviving victims, families of the deceased, and the detectives who worked on the case recount their stories. S1, Ep2
